summary:
Salesforce最新季度財報展現強勁獲利能力，EPS大幅超預期且營收穩健成長。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為5.90美元，大幅優於預期的3.27美元。
• 季度營收達到113.5億美元，較去年同期成長10.83%。
• 獲利能力顯著提升，展現成本控制與營運效率的最佳化。
• 核心業務維持穩健擴張，企業級客戶需求保持韌性。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報發布強烈的獲利超預期訊號，顯示公司在維持營收雙位數成長的同時成功優化利潤率。對短中期股價具正向支撐作用，有助於緩解市場對軟體需求放緩的擔憂。後續應追蹤AI產品的營收貢獻佔比及剩餘履約價值（RPO）的成長動能。

需留意：總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響企業IT支出與軟體採購預算。；人工智慧產品（如Agentforce）的商業化變現速度仍需時間驗證。

summary_en:
Salesforce reported strong quarterly results with a significant EPS beat and solid revenue growth.
• EPS came in at $5.90, significantly beating the estimated $3.27.
• Quarterly revenue reached $11.35 billion, representing a 10.83% YoY growth.
• Significant margin expansion demonstrated successful cost control and operational efficiency.
• Core enterprise business maintained steady expansion with resilient demand.

ai_view_en:
view: The significant EPS beat sends a strong positive signal, demonstrating successful margin optimization alongside double-digit top-line growth. This should provide positive support for the stock in the near-to-mid term and alleviate concerns over software demand slowdowns. Key metrics to track include AI product revenue contribution and remaining performance obligations (RPO) growth momentum.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact enterprise IT spending and software budgets.; Monetization pace and adoption speed of AI products like Agentforce require time to validate.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS達5.90美元，優於市場預期的3.27美元。
